purpose: Preserve weak, generic, third-party, duplicate, or poorly evidenced material without letting it occupy the active/public surface.
laws: FILENAME OR VIBE IS NOT PROVENANCE
PROMOTION REQUIRES IDENTITY + PROVENANCE + MECHANISM + PAY-RENT + RETURN

zones.QUARANTINE: Source may be retained; no public promotion until a named mechanism pays rent.
zones.ATTIC: Rejected/irrelevant candidate retained as negative knowledge to prevent repeated rediscovery.
zones.HOLD: Potentially relevant but provenance or identity is insufficient.

entries.reason: Hero/features/pricing/dashboard polish is not evidence of a distinct operation.
entries.allowed_salvage: One named reusable mechanism, content fragment, or interaction that passes the promotion gate.
entries.forbidden: Beautify, rename into a new project, or place on primary nav merely because it renders.
